correctness.rationale: Arbitrary antiderivative tests in x and y yield \(\mathbb E[y\mid x]=0\) and \(\mathbb E[z\mid y]=0\), hence the four zero first/mixed moments used in the proof. Stationarity of z then gives \(\mathbb E[xz]=-a\), while stationarity of xy gives \(\mathbb E[y^2]+\mathbb E[xz]=0\), so \(\mathbb E[y^2]=a\). Nonnegativity excludes a<0. At a=0, zero y square plus support invariance forces y=z=0, exactly the equilibrium line. For a>0, the variance/covariance formulas and Cauchy--Schwarz are immediate, and nonzero zero-mean y has both signs. The exact checker independently verifies all generator identities and the a=3/4 specialization.

value.rationale: NE6 was introduced as a no-equilibrium chaotic flow at positive forcing. The exact law \(\mathbb E[y^2]=a\) converts that forcing into a sharp compact-recurrence boundary, completely classifies the critical parameter, and fixes the RMS amplitude and a covariance for every recurrent statistical state at positive a. That is a natural structural invariant of the source family.
residual_risks: Positive-a existence remains conditional rather than proved for all a.

final_claim: For the Jafari--Sprott NE6 family \(\dot x=y\), \(\dot y=z\), \(\dot z=-y-xz-yz-a\), every compactly supported invariant probability measure satisfies \(\mathbb E[y\mid x]=0\), \(\mathbb E[z\mid y]=0\), \(\mathbb E[y^2]=a\), and \(\mathbb E[xz]=-a\). Hence no such measure exists for \(a<0\); at \(a=0\) they are exactly compact probabilities on the equilibrium line; and for \(a>0\) the stated variance/covariance and sign consequences hold.
limitations: For \(a>0\) the theorem gives necessary stationary laws and does not prove a compact attractor exists for every parameter.
